about_the_game:
Dweller is a slow-burning, first-person psychological walking-simulator horror inspired by atmospheric narrative experiences like Firewatch, but twisted into something darker. Set in the rotting sewer systems beneath an abandoned city, it’s not about action or quick scares, but about deliberate exploration, unsettling radio conversations, and a growing sense of dread that follows every step.

Gameplay

  • A heavy, immersive walk-sim focused on atmosphere and slow-building dread.

  • Explore the dark, twisted sewer network and piece together secrets through eerie radio conversations.

  • No cheap jump scares, just relentless dread and deadly encounters. The deeper you go, the more your senses fail, your gear falters, your mind fractures… and terrifying enemies close in.

Story

You have been dispatched into the city’s sewer system following a series of unexplained system failures and escalating paranormal reports. Maintenance logs indicate that critical data tapes, records of experimental monitoring equipment installed years ago, were never retrieved.

Those tapes are believed to contain the only remaining evidence explaining the anomalies now affecting the infrastructure above. With communications disrupted and personnel unavailable, the task falls to you alone: locate the tapes and upload their contents before the situation worsens.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains mild violence, blood, and horror themes. It includes disturbing imagery, psychological horror and intense scenes that may be unsettling to some players.

short_description: Dweller is a psychological walking sim horror game where you're trapped in a rotting sewer system with something watching your every move. You're low on resources, high on tension, and the only voice you hear might be trying to help... or mess with your head. Trust no one. Stay quiet. Stay alive.
